timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,400–1,500 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly—the exchange rate has fallen below 1,500 KRW/USD and is settling into the 1,400 won range, driven by a massive dollar inflow from SK Hynix's ADR listing (~40 trillion won equivalent). This means you need fewer Korean won to buy your $2,000, making it relatively cheaper to convert right now.

TIP: Lock in this conversion while the won remains strong; if the dollar inflow effect fades, the rate could weaken back toward 1,500+ won/USD, raising your monthly cost.
